relTest.notes:
• Commercial jobs: one job groups its buildings. On the computer, New → Commercial sets up the job (client, claim, start and end dates), building types, buildings (address, permits, which way the front faces, units, attic and roof), occupants and typical conditions.
• On the camera: the 🏢 building chip (switch building, unit status, still to visit, add a unit, typical condition, job days); the arrows go unit to unit; room chips (Kitchen, Bedroom 1…) set the location tag; the occupant card with Call.
• Elevations from the compass once the building's front is set.
• Each day on site is logged with the times and the day's weather.
• Interviews per unit.
• Each building's inspection file lists the typical conditions and a table of units and conditions from the photo notes (also on the computer, with a .csv download).
• Commercial projects keep the green shutter.
